script.notIndependentlyTranslatableReason: ta.accdist's LEVEL is a cumulative-from-first-bar, unseeded accumulator -- the exact same architecture class already ruled unimplementable for ta.obv (RISK_REGISTER.md; no absolute seed is observable). Only a WINDOWED DELTA (accdist - accdist[k]) cancels the unknown seed, mirroring the already-shipped obvN(k) / boundedObvAgainstOwnAverage pattern. This observation verifies the k=5 windowed delta's per-bar contribution formula, not the unimplementable raw level.

engine.note: DELIBERATELY NOT IMPLEMENTED -- no accdistN(k) primitive exists in either kernel, and none is proposed. The per-bar money-flow-multiplier formula this observation verifies would support the SAME obvN/pvtN-style windowed-delta rewrite if a corpus script ever needed `ta.accdist <cmp> ta.accdist[k]`, but the one blind-corpus script that names ta.accdist (volume-dollar-volume-money-flow) needs an EMA-based comparison instead (adTrend = adLine > ta.ema(adLine,20)), which no bounded-delta primitive can serve -- see closedTable.json's `_functions_excluded.accdist`. This observation exists to record the vendor evidence behind that ruling's per-bar formula claim, not to back an implementation.

input.note: ad_change5 = ta.accdist - ta.accdist[5] (the builtin's own 5-bar windowed delta, real chart OHLCV) plotted alongside ad_deltaSumCandReal5 = math.sum(realMfv,5) where realMfv = mfm*volume, mfm = ((close-low)-(high-close))/(high-low) with real high/low/close/volume (never the script's synthetic o/h/l/c/v -- ta.accdist is a bare builtin that cannot be redirected to a custom source, so the candidate must also be built from the real OHLCV or the two are on incomparable scales).
